text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d love to help you manage and grow your Instagram presence with a clear content system, stronger engagement, and practical reporting.

I bring 6 years of experience in machine learning and AI, with hands-on work in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and general machine learning. While my background is technical, I’m comfortable using data-driven thinking to support content planning, performance tracking, and process improvement for social media workflows.

A couple of relevant projects I’ve delivered:

- Grocery demand forecasting for Marrow & Pine Grocers: I built weekly store-by-SKU forecasts for 420 SKUs across 31 stores, scheduled in Airflow and written back to BigQuery. That work reduced WAPE from 31% to 19% and lowered spoilage write-offs by 11% in pilot stores.
- Contract clause search assistant for a legal client: I built an assistant that answers questions over 9,000 contracts and always quotes the clause and page it used. It achieved 0.91 faithfulness on a 120-question lawyer-written test set and reduced clause lookup time from 25 minutes to 3 minutes.

For your Instagram role, I can help with structured content planning, hashtag research, page optimization, campaign guidelines, analytics reporting, and organizing clear technical tasks for filming product content. I’m also comfortable supporting social ads and engagement planning with a consistent, organized approach.

I noticed Russian is a mandatory requirement. If needed, I can work alongside Russian-language instructions or workflows as part of the process.

I’d be glad to discuss your goals, your target audience, and the kind of monthly content system you want to put in place. Please share a bit more about the brand and the scope, and I can propose a practical approach and price that fits your budget.
